title: Flow Proximity Connect
description: Add proximity connect to compatible channels in flow DAG.
summary: Implemented proximity connect for flow DAG channels: configurable world-space distance on GraphEngine (default 48, 0 disables), wire-snap and node-drag auto-connect to nearest compatible in/out channel with live highlighted pending_edge preview, replace-on-occupied 1-to-1 semantics, plumbed through DagHost/FlowHost/FlowSession wasm, FlowCanvas proximityDistance prop, and Flow window Proximity slider measure (0–240). Tests extended in mathematical/graph, dag host, flow/react, and flow/play.
